environment.description: EC2 c5.xlarge instance running identical Amazon Linux 2 AMI in a private subnet (10.0.2.0/24). The subnet's route table has local routes only (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) with no route entry for 0.0.0.0/0 — no Internet Gateway association, no NAT Gateway, no NAT instance, no VPC peering to any subnet with egress, no Transit Gateway attachment. Security group egress rules allow only TCP 5432 to 10.0.2.50/32 (RDS endpoint). VPC has no VPC endpoints for S3, SSM, or any AWS service that could proxy traffic. Network ACL on the subnet explicitly denies all traffic to destinations outside 10.0.0.0/16 (rule 50: DENY all protocols 0.0.0.0/0 outbound, rule 100: ALLOW TCP 5432 10.0.2.50/32 outbound). DNS resolution is VPC-internal only (enableDnsSupport=true, no Route53 outbound resolver endpoints). Instance has no public IP, no Elastic IP. The binary is compiled identically (-O2 -fno-stack-protector) and glibc 2.26 tcache is present — the double-free IS triggerable and heap corruption DOES occur.
